text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega wasn't feeling well,
so I had her rest in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It is really nothing significant, but...
if you insist so strongly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Where is... this...?
Welcome to Fluffy Kindergarten~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sheep
text_block_list.text: I'm a sheep!

text_block_list.name: Pomeranian
text_block_list.text: I'm a Pomeranian~!

text_block_list.name: Spotted Seal
text_block_list.text: I'm a widdle baby spotted seal.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wh... There's so much... fluffiness...!

text_block_list.name: Pomeranian
text_block_list.text: Big sis, do you like us?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......Well.
It's not that I... dislike it, but...

text_block_list.name: Sheep
text_block_list.text:
Let's play together~!
We have Mr. Alpaca and Ms. Chinchilla too!

text_block_list.name: Spotted Seal
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take a nap too, yesh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, don't...
We don't have time for that... seriously..."

text_block_list.name: Sheep
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Ready, and...

text_block_list.name: Fluffy Creatures
text_block_list.text: It's so soft and super fluffy~~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ugh, waaah... ah...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stop it, don't look at me like that...
No, I'm... being drawn in...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That wasn't bad.

Admire Vega was thoroughly healed in her dream,
and returned with a refreshed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I told you we didn't have time!

Admire Vega had overslept.
Her condition didn't improve, and she ended up
beating herself up for sleeping too much...
